limitations: The initial run omitted the immutable public fixture and reported four public skips. The prepared run passes those public checks before registry edits.
The four consumer mappings cover ten named checks. Their controlled-clock fixtures do not qualify production native clocks, live providers, or fleet storage.
The global 50-case summary remains incomplete because this invocation selects only eight CSP4 component subcases. Full A09, A10, and A21 qualification remains with CSP10.
Native Windows access, production clock composition, follower adoption, safe takeover, explicit transitions, remaining delivery checks, review, and merges still prevent CSP4 completion.
